summary.en: “The shared footage shows Turkish soldiers marching in the streets of Germany” is contradicted by dogrulukpayi.com. “Germans were amazed upon seeing the Turkish commandos” is misleading according to dogrulukpayi.com. The shared video does not show Turkish soldiers marching in the streets of Germany. Fact-checks confirm the footage is from a 2020 Victory Day parade in Baku, Azerbaijan. While a Turkish military convoy was in Germany for a NATO exercise in February 2026 and surprised local onlookers, the post misleadingly uses unrelated footage to exaggerate the event.
